# jamfplatform_pro_local_admin_password_settings (Data Source)

Read the current Jamf Pro local administrator password (LAPS) settings (UI: Settings → Computer Management → Security → "Password settings for managed local administrator accounts"). One record per tenant.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Device secrets | Local Admin Passwords (LAPS) | Update | `local-admin-passwords` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Jamf Software LLC 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Read the current Jamf Pro local administrator password (LAPS) settings.
data "jamfplatform_pro_local_admin_password_settings" "this" {}

output "rotation_interval" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_local_admin_password_settings.this.rotation_interval
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier. Always `singleton`.
- `laps_for_prestage_accounts_enabled` (Boolean) Whether LAPS is enabled for managed local administrator accounts created via PreStage enrollment.
- `rotation_after_viewing_interval` (String) How long after a password is viewed in the inventory record before it is rotated.
- `rotation_interval` (String) How often passwords are automatically rotated, or `Never` when automatic rotation is off.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
